description: This PHP class 'ConsoleMilestoneListener' listens to various project and investment events in the Goteo crowdfunding platform to create milestones and trigger related actions such as notifications and event logging.

classes.name: ConsoleMilestoneListener
classes.description: A listener class that handles project milestones creation based on project publish, activation, reward fulfillment, and investment success events.

methods.name: create_milestone
methods.description: Creates a milestone for a given project and type, fires an event, and handles duplicated event exceptions.

methods.name: onProjectPublish
methods.description: Handles project publish event to create an 'on-publish' milestone.

methods.name: onProjectActive
methods.description: Handles project activation event to create a 'day-X' milestone based on days active.

methods.name: onProjectWatch
methods.description: Handles project watch event to create milestones when rewards are fulfilled.

methods.name: onInvestSucceeded
methods.description: Handles successful investment event to create milestones based on investment percentage, amount, and number of donors.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this class subscribes to, linking them to handler methods.
